preconditions.description: The number of test cases, T, is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The length of the permutation, N, is between 3 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of all N values across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is a permutation of length N
postconditions.description: The output is a sequence of N integers where each integer from 1 to N appears exactly once.

postconditions.expression: No two adjacent elements have a bitwise XOR equal to the next element
postconditions.description: For any permutation P, P_i XOR P_{i+1} != P_{i+2} for all i in the range 1 to N-2.

postconditions.expression: Output is either a valid permutation or -1 if no such permutation exists
postconditions.description: If a valid permutation exists, it should be printed. If no such permutation exists, -1 should be printed.
